Its low durability doesn’t lend itself to extended use.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 7 |durability = 18 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lizal Spear}} Lizal Spears are [[Weapon]]s, bearing the ripping edge characteristic of [[Lizalfos]] design. These designs are common among other pieces of [[Lizalfos Gear]], which includes all Weapons created by Lizalfos.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} They are wielded by low-tier Lizalfos, most commonly in the [[Lanayru Wetlands]] and [[East Necluda]]. [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]] also use them on occasion. Because of their low durability, Lizal Spears do not last very long in combat. Due to their metallic spearheads, Lizal Spears will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked back up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
